title: C&C3 Tiberium Wars Assets for Red Alert
description:
[h1]C&C3 Tiberium Wars Assets[/h1]

Command & Conquer 3 units, effects, sounds and voices for Red Alert, in HD. Built for Command & Conquer Remastered Collection.

This is an asset pack: on its own it adds nothing to the game. A mod has to use it.

The same pack for Tiberian Dawn is a separate item: each game reads art only from its own folder.

If the game crashes on the splash screen, the extra art needs more video memory than it has: add NOSPLASHPRELOAD to the game's launch options.

[h2]Using the assets in your own mod[/h2]

Every object, cameo and sound is named with the C3 prefix, so nothing clashes with the base game's own assets.

Enable this pack beside your mod (the game finds its art and sounds in any enabled mod) and copy the entries you need from this pack's Data/XML files into your mod's RA_*.XML, RABUILDABLES.XML and SFXEVENTS*.XML. Each object needs a classic-mode SHP with the same frame count (a transparent stub is enough) and its ImageData set in your DLL's Init or One_Time ([url=https://github.com/electronicarts/CnC_Remastered_Collection/blob/master/REDALERT/ADATA.CPP#L2590]EA's example[/url]).

[h2]Contents[/h2]

[b]Units[/b] (4): C3MK3, C3MK3RAIL, C3PRED, C3PREDRAIL

[b]Effects[/b] (6): C3RAILGLOW, C3RAILGLOWO, C3RAILHIT, C3RAILHITO, C3RAILMZ, C3RAILMZO

[b]Sidebar cameos[/b] (2): BuildIcon_C3MK3, BuildIcon_C3PRED

[b]Sounds (Data/AUDIO)[/b] (60): C3MATA, C3MATB, C3MATC, C3MATD, C3MATE, C3MATF, C3MGUN1, C3MGUN10, C3MGUN11, C3MGUN12, C3MGUN2, C3MGUN3, C3MGUN4, C3MGUN5, C3MGUN6, C3MGUN7, C3MGUN8, C3MGUN9, C3MMOA, C3MMOB, C3MMOC, C3MMOD, C3MMOE, C3MMOF, C3MPOD1, C3MPOD2, C3MPOD3, C3MPOD4, C3MSEA, C3MSEB, C3MSEC, C3MSED, C3MSEE, C3MSEF, C3PATA, C3PATB, C3PATC, C3PATD, C3PATE, C3PATF, C3PGUN1, C3PGUN2, C3PGUN3, C3PGUN4, C3PGUN5, C3PGUN6, C3PGUN7, C3PGUN8, C3PGUN9, C3PMOA, C3PMOB, C3PMOC, C3PMOD, C3PMOE, C3PSEA, C3PSEB, C3PSEC, C3PSED, C3PSEE, C3PSEF

XML files: CNC3AssetsBuildables.xml, CNC3Assets_UNITS.XML, CNC3Assets_VFX.XML, SFXEventsCNC3Assets.xml.

[h2]Shape data[/h2]

The classic sizes and frame counts of every object, and the frame layouts, are in the pinned discussion "Shape data" and in the README in the pack's folder.

[h2]AI disclosure[/h2]

These sprites were rendered from the game's own 3D models; no AI generated the art.
The scripts and tools that build this pack were written with AI assistance. The original designs, sounds and voices are Electronic Arts'.

[h2]Credits[/h2]

Original Command & Conquer 3: Tiberium Wars art and sounds: Electronic Arts.
Rendered for Remastered from the game's own models by gibbo101.
